tokens.name: kid-bg
tokens.usage: Kid zone page ground: every kid screen.

tokens.name: kid-surface
tokens.usage: Kid soft surfaces: keypad keys, replay button, emoji groups-of-five.

tokens.name: kid-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Kid cards that lift: story card, avatar tile, choice tile, trail stones.

tokens.name: kid-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of kid surfaces.

tokens.name: kid-ink
tokens.usage: All kid text and icons on kid-bg, kid-surface, kid-surface-raised and kid-pressed.

tokens.name: kid-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Captions and narration lines on kid-bg, kid-surface and kid-surface-raised. Quiet controls like the flag button.

tokens.name: kid-line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the trail ahead of the child. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: kid-line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders in the kid zone (choice tile, keypad display, ten-frame cells). 3:1 on kid grounds.

tokens.name: trail
tokens.usage: Brand amber: primary kid buttons, the walked trail, the next stop. Fill only, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-trail
tokens.usage: Text and icons on trail fills.

tokens.name: trail-deep
tokens.usage: Amber as text or mark on kid-bg and kid-surface-raised: current progress dot, accents.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Glow ring around the next stop on the trail. Decorative.

tokens.name: meadow
tokens.usage: Ground of the trail map panel.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Star fill: the only reward. Always paired with a star-ink outline.

tokens.name: star-ink
tokens.usage: Star outline and mastered-stone border, 3:1 on every kid ground.

tokens.name: counter
tokens.usage: Filled ten-frame dots on kid-surface-raised.

tokens.name: hit-bg
tokens.usage: Right answer: tile and feedback panel ground.

tokens.name: hit-ink
tokens.usage: Right answer text, icon and border on hit-bg.

tokens.name: miss-bg
tokens.usage: Missed answer: calm blue ground. Never red.

tokens.name: miss-ink
tokens.usage: Missed answer text, icon and border on miss-bg.

tokens.name: av-peach
tokens.usage: Avatar disc: fox, lion, cheetah.

tokens.name: av-mint
tokens.usage: Avatar disc: frog, dinosaur, panda.

tokens.name: av-sky
tokens.usage: Avatar disc: owl, penguin.

tokens.name: av-lilac
tokens.usage: Avatar disc: unicorn, octopus.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring in both zones: 3px solid, 3px offset. The offset puts it on the ground beside a control, where it holds 3:1 on every kid and parent surface.

tokens.name: p-bg
tokens.usage: Parent zone page ground.

tokens.name: p-surface
tokens.usage: Parent cards, inputs, PIN keys.

tokens.name: p-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Switch track (off), skeleton bars, inset areas.

tokens.name: p-ink
tokens.usage: Parent text on p-bg, p-surface, p-surface-sunken, p-primary-soft and p-danger-soft.

tokens.name: p-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, hints, placeholders on p-bg and p-surface.

tokens.name: p-line
tokens.usage: Row dividers and card edges. Decorative.

tokens.name: p-line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and secondary button borders. 3:1 on p-surface.

tokens.name: p-primary
tokens.usage: Parent primary buttons, links, selected chips, switch on. Text on p-bg and p-surface.

tokens.name: on-p-primary
tokens.usage: Text on p-primary fills.

tokens.name: p-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip ground.

tokens.name: p-danger
tokens.usage: Parent zone only: delete, reset, errors. Text on p-surface and p-danger-soft. Never in the kid zone.

tokens.name: on-p-danger
tokens.usage: Text on p-danger fills.

tokens.name: p-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Open confirm panel ground.

tokens.name: p-ok
tokens.usage: Success status lines (export done) on p-surface, always with a check icon.

tokens.name: state-unknown
tokens.usage: Skill state Unknown: ink on state-unknown-bg. Icon: question mark. Dashed border.

tokens.name: state-unknown-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Unknown badge ground.

tokens.name: state-assumed
tokens.usage: Skill state Assumed: ink on state-assumed-bg. Icon: half circle. Dotted border.

tokens.name: state-assumed-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Assumed badge ground.

tokens.name: state-gap
tokens.usage: Skill state Gap: ink on state-gap-bg. Icon: broken ring. Orange, never red.

tokens.name: state-gap-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Gap badge ground.

tokens.name: state-learning
tokens.usage: Skill state Learning: ink on state-learning-bg. Icon: sprout.

tokens.name: state-learning-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Learning badge ground.

tokens.name: state-mastered
tokens.usage: Skill state Mastered: ink on state-mastered-bg. Icon: star. Thick border.

tokens.name: state-mastered-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Mastered badge ground.

tokens.name: state-review
tokens.usage: Skill state Review due: ink on state-review-bg. Icon: circular arrow.

tokens.name: state-review-bg
tokens.usage: Skill state Review due badge ground.

styles.name: kid-numeral
styles.usage: Story card short text, keypad display. Scales 1.4x on tablet.

styles.name: kid-caption
styles.usage: Avatar names, trail stop names, button captions.

styles.name: kid-narration
styles.usage: Narration shown as a caption. 24px in reading mode.

styles.name: p-body
styles.sample: Pick 10 skills and check each against what you know of your child.

styles.name: dys-prompt
styles.usage: Replaces kid-prompt when the dyslexia font is on.

styles.name: dys-body
styles.sample: Narration starts off. For kids who read on their own.
styles.usage: Replaces p-body for parents who turn it on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and badges; between progress dots.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between keypad keys and parent rows' parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Parent screen side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between parent sections; story card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between kid screen blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Large separations on tablet.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Parent buttons and inputs; ten-frame.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Parent cards; keypad keys.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Choice tiles, keypad display.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Story card, avatar tile, feedback panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Kid buttons, chips, badges, stones.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Kid pressables: a solid ledge, no blur, cheap on low-end Android. Removed on press.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge-trail
tokens.usage: Ledge under trail-filled buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The story card only: one blurred shadow per screen.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Parent cards and PIN keys.

size.note: Kid sizes multiply by scale-tablet on tablets.

tokens.name: tap-kid
tokens.usage: Minimum kid tap target, phone.

tokens.name: tap-parent
tokens.usage: Minimum parent tap target.

tokens.name: icon-kid
tokens.usage: Icons in kid buttons.

tokens.name: icon-parent
tokens.usage: Icons in parent buttons and rows.

tokens.name: scale-tablet
tokens.usage: Kid zone multiplier when the short side is 600pt or more.

duration.note: Every animation is skippable and off under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Ledge press-down.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Tile color change on answer, switch thumb.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Feedback panel slide-in, card change.

tokens.name: dur-star
tokens.usage: Star landing on the trail. The longest motion in the app.

tokens.name: ease-gentle
tokens.usage: Everything that moves. No bounce, no overshoot.
